user_turn_1: My 24-hour Budapest travelcard is valid until tonight. Can I use it on any bus?
agent_turn_1:
Generally, yes—on ordinary covered bus routes. The 24-hour Budapest travelcard is listed in the 5 November 2026 snapshot, and ordinary bus routes follow the usual ticket/pass rules. The key exception for your question is 100E: it has separate airport-shuttle fare rules, so the travelcard alone doesn't cover it. 200E follows ordinary ticket/pass rules.
